title: Mastercard took down payments across Australia with a scheduled update
summary: Mastercard payments stopped working across Australia on Saturday afternoon. “ A scheduled system update caused Mastercard transactions to be declined for a period of time earlier today, ” the company said, adding that the situation is resolved and all systems are working…
